description: This file defines the RedisSettings class, which encapsulates configuration properties for Redis connection such as host, port, user, password, database, and queue key. It also provides a method to generate a connection string based on these settings.

classes.name: RedisSettings
classes.description: A class representing configuration settings for connecting to a Redis server, including methods to generate a connection string.

methods.name: ToConnectionString
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Redis connection string using the stored configuration properties.
